messages.content: How about we check the soil moisture in a few of the pots tomorrow? I'm curious if the compost is making a difference in how quickly they dry out.
That sounds like a great idea. Checking the soil moisture levels daily is a great way to see how the compost is affecting the plants. Just let me know if you see any big changes!
Sure, I'll do that. I'll also try to check a few pots today to see if there's any noticeable difference in the soil texture. Maybe that'll give us a better idea of what to look for tomorrow.

Sounds like a good plan. Checking the texture and moisture levels across the different pots will definitely give you some interesting insights into how the compost is performing. Keep me updated on what you discover!
I'll keep an eye on the moisture too, especially since the heat is so unpredictable. If one pot dries out faster, that might tell us something about the compost mix.
